rules.name: Scrum Swarm Task Breakdown & Mandatory Reviewer
rules.definition: All features and fixes must be decomposed into atomic Scrum tasks on the Kanban board, assigned to specialized agent skills, and must include a designated Reviewer agent before sign-off.

rules.name: Pessimistic Row-Locking on Class Capacity
rules.definition: Course enrollment must execute in an atomic transaction with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on t_jadwal_kuliah. Overbooking class quota is strictly forbidden.

rules.name: Zero N+1 Query & Eager Loading Policy
rules.definition: All Eloquent queries in controllers and services must eager load relations via with() or loadMissing(). Lazy loading is disabled in non-production.

rules.name: Strict Multi-Role RBAC & Department Data Isolation
rules.definition: Enforce RBAC across 14+ roles at route and query levels. Department operators (userprodi, usertu) must never access records outside their assigned prodi_id.

rules.name: Immutable Grade Locking & Audit Trigger
rules.definition: Finalized gradebooks must transition to LOCKED. Revisions require Dean authorization and must record modifier identity in PostgreSQL simak_audit_log triggers.

rules.name: Checkpointed Neo Feeder Batch Sync & Pre-validation
rules.definition: Neo Feeder sync must validate NIK, SKS, and IPK locally before API dispatch and record checkpoints in feeder_sync_checkpoints to guarantee zero rejected batches.

rules.name: Financial Clearance Gate for KRS & Graduation
rules.definition: Students cannot enroll in KRS, sit for exams, or submit thesis defense without verified SETTLEMENT status on semester tuition (UKT/IPI) via Midtrans billing.

rules.name: OBE 100% Weight Mathematical Consistency
rules.definition: Assessment component weights mapped to CPMK in syllabus (RPS) must sum to exactly 100.00%. Incomplete or mismatched weights must be mathematically rejected.

rules.name: Declarative Partitioning & Non-Destructive Migrations
rules.definition: Partition t_presensi_perkuliahan and simak_audit_log declaratively by semester or year. Production migrations must never execute destructive DROP operations.

rules.name: WCAG 2.1 AA & Accessible Academic Interface
rules.definition: Academic data tables, schedule matrices, and form badges must maintain minimum 4.5:1 color contrast and full keyboard navigation in both Light and Dark themes.

rules.name: Service-Action Pattern & Thin Controllers
rules.definition: Keep Laravel controllers thin (request validation and response dispatch). Encapsulate all business rules, transactions, and calculations in Services and Actions.

rules.name: Asynchronous Queues for Heavy Documents & Feeder Jobs
rules.definition: Bulk PDF transcript exports, grade ledger compilations, and Neo Feeder synchronizations must be dispatched to Redis background queues, never run synchronously.
